summary: You set your own Active Directory naming for PIM for AD, and you can watch the sync as it happens.

new.title: Your own naming for PIM for AD
new.text: Settings > Hybrid Active Directory sets how PIM groups, admin accounts and per-server groups map to your Active Directory. A preview shows the names the hybrid worker will use.

new.title: A live view of the hybrid sync
new.text: Jobs > hybrid-ad-sync > Live view follows every pass: members per group, time left in AD against the PIM activation, and every add, correction and removal.
